text: Binance reports a security incident with an estimated $6.3 billion impact and approximately $3 billion in frozen assets. Withdrawal services remain restricted while deposits continue operating. Bitcoin falls 4% to $77,465, Ether declines 4%, and BNB drops 5%.

meta.note: The reported impact is preliminary; frozen assets are distinct from confirmed losses, and the intrusion mechanism remains under investigation.

text: The BOJ holds its policy rate at 1.25% by an 8-1 vote, with one member favoring 1.5%. It assesses underlying inflation as generally consistent with its 2% target for the first time since 2013. Fiscal 2027 inflation forecasts rise to 2.6% headline and 2.7% core-core.

meta.note: The underlying inflation assessment differs from observed CPI; fiscal 2027 figures are forecasts.

text: BP reports $8.5 billion in quarterly underlying replacement cost profit, up from $2.2 billion, with refining margins of $46.70 per barrel. Nine-month operating cash flow rises to $28.55 billion from $16.89 billion, while net debt declines to $13.87 billion. Refining reliability exceeds 96%.

meta.note: Profit and refining margins are quarterly; operating cash flow and net debt comparisons cover nine months.

text: Euro area GDP grows 0.4% in Q3, down from 0.6% in Q2 but above the 0.2% forecast. France contracts 0.1%, Germany expands 0.2%, Italy remains flat, Spain grows 0.6%, and Ireland rises 5.5%. National growth rates remain uneven across the currency union.

meta.note: Figures are quarter-over-quarter; Ireland's multinational-heavy GDP is volatile and subject to revision.
